name: grant-outfitbot
description: Premium Telegram Online Store Mini App, Bot & Express Backend with Supabase

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix bot install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,BOT,FRONTEND" -c "blue,green,magenta" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix bot run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm install --include=dev && npm --prefix frontend install --include=dev && npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix bot install

author: Antigravity
